title: A Concise Review of Scientific Research at EQ-SANS: Advancing Nanoscale Science Across Diverse Disciplines

contributions.purpose: 综述EQ-SANS仪器跨学科的科研成果
contributions.mechanism: 按主题归类(高分子/生物与仿生/纳米材料与胶体/能源材料/环境应用)综合大量已发表工作
contributions.evaluation: 定性综述:覆盖0.5nm至数百nm尺度、该仪器贡献的300+篇出版物,无原创实验或新数据
contributions.domain: 中子小角散射/纳米科学
contributions.source_quote: This review highlights key research advancements using EQ-SANS, spanning polymer science, biological and biomimetic systems, nanomaterials and colloids, energy materials, and environmental applications.

contributions.purpose: 梳理SANS数据分析的AI/ML方法进展
contributions.mechanism: 综述深度学习超分辨CNN、ML反演、VAE、矩展开、PhaseLift、高斯过程回归(GPR),及LLM+RAG的EQ-SANS助手聊天机器人ESAC
contributions.evaluation: 定性:这些方法相比传统拟合更快更准,但均为他人成果转述,本文未做对比实验
contributions.source_quote: the EQ-SANS Assisting Chatbot (ESAC) has been introduced, leveraging Large Language Models (LLM) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to enhance user experience by providing an interactive reference and automating script generation.

contributions.purpose: 总结仪器方法学与硬件增强并展望
contributions.mechanism: 综述探测器几何畸变校正、自动化数据处理、非弹性散射修正、IC-DAS控制系统及未来加速器升级
contributions.evaluation: 定性:加速器升级将提升中子通量,可测更小样本/更快变化/更细结构,无量化指标
contributions.source_quote: planned upgrades to the accelerator and the consequent increased neutron flux expected to enhance its capabilities significantly.

notes: 非实证类综述(instrument facility review),无原创研究/实验/新数据,全文为对300+篇既有EQ-SANS论文的主题化转述。协议适配问题:本任务四元组面向'贡献',但综述本身无可评测的新结果,evaluation字段只能记综述覆盖面(定性),不适用负结果/数字。AI披露值得注意且与其他篇不同:假设开发[A](人类≥95%),实验设计[C]、数据分析[C](AI辅助为主),写作[D](AI主导)——即研究本身人类主导、成文由AI完成,checklist问4-8实验相关多为NA(承认无实验)。无数据造假红旗;质量问题在于novelty近乎为零(纯文献汇编),这可能是desk-reject原因。ESAC等条目暴露本文所述工作大量依赖LLM工具。
